purpose: Research on weight in type 2 diabetes to inform lifestyle counselling.
question: What is the median BMI of adults with type 2 diabetes in each region?
definitions: Adult = aged 18 or older on 31 December 2025.
Type 2 diabetes = any condition with an ICD-10 code starting with E11.
Use the latest BMI (LOINC 39156-5) per patient; patients without a BMI are left out.
Report per region: number of adults with a BMI and their median BMI, one decimal.
